universal.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
universal.description: Direct income support of ₹6,000/year to all landholding farmer families, paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each.
universal.eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land

universal.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
universal.description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme covering yield losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases at subsidized premiums.
universal.eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas

universal.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
universal.description: Provides short-term credit for cultivation, post-harvest expenses, and farm maintenance at subsidized interest rates as low as 4% p.a.
universal.eligibility: All farmers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and SHGs

rice.name: Minimum Support Price (MSP) for Rice
rice.description: Government guarantees purchase of paddy at a fixed MSP, protecting farmers from market price crashes.
rice.eligibility: All rice-growing farmers registered with local procurement centers

rice.name: National Food Security Mission – Rice
rice.description: Subsidized distribution of certified seeds, micro-nutrients, and soil ameliorants to boost rice productivity.

wheat.name: Minimum Support Price (MSP) for Wheat
wheat.description: Government procurement at guaranteed MSP, ensuring stable income for wheat farmers.
wheat.eligibility: All wheat-growing farmers registered with local mandis

wheat.name: National Food Security Mission – Wheat
wheat.description: Promotes high-yielding wheat varieties with input subsidies including seeds, fertilizers, and farm machinery.
wheat.benefitAmount: Up to ₹7,500/ha for HYV seeds & machinery
wheat.eligibility: Wheat farmers in low-productivity NFSM districts

maize.name: Minimum Support Price (MSP) for Maize
maize.description: Guaranteed procurement of maize at fixed MSP to protect farmers from volatile market prices.

maize.name: National Food Security Mission – Coarse Cereals
maize.description: Promotes maize cultivation through subsidized hybrid seeds, bio-fertilizers, and demonstrations in targeted districts.
maize.benefitAmount: Up to ₹4,500/ha for hybrid seeds & nutrients
maize.eligibility: Maize farmers in NFSM coarse-cereals districts

chickpea.name: National Food Security Mission – Pulses
chickpea.description: Heavily subsidizes pulse crop cultivation with free foundation seeds, micro-nutrients, and plant protection chemicals.
chickpea.eligibility: Pulse farmers in all NFSM-designated districts

chickpea.name: Minimum Support Price (MSP) for Gram/Chickpea
chickpea.description: Guaranteed government procurement at MSP to incentivize pulse production and reduce import dependency.

cotton.name: Minimum Support Price (MSP) for Cotton
cotton.description: Government guarantees minimum price for cotton procurement through CCI, protecting from market volatility.
cotton.eligibility: All cotton farmers with produce meeting Fair Average Quality (FAQ)

cotton.name: Technology Mission on Cotton (TMC)
cotton.description: Subsidized Bt cotton seeds, IPM demonstrations, and modern ginning & pressing equipment for cotton farmers.
cotton.eligibility: Cotton farmers in major cotton-growing states

sugarcane.name: Fair & Remunerative Price (FRP) for Sugarcane
sugarcane.description: Legally mandated minimum price that sugar mills must pay farmers, linked to sugar recovery rates.
sugarcane.eligibility: All sugarcane-supplying farmers registered with sugar mills

sugarcane.name: Sugar Industry Support & Financial Scheme
sugarcane.description: Government assists in clearing cane arrears by providing soft loans to sugar mills, ensuring timely farmer payments.
sugarcane.eligibility: Sugarcane farmers with pending mill dues

coffee.name: Coffee Board Development Subsidy
coffee.description: Financial assistance for new coffee plantations, replanting, and quality improvement programs by the Coffee Board of India.
coffee.eligibility: Small & marginal coffee growers in traditional coffee-growing areas

coffee.name: Coffee Quality Improvement Programme
coffee.description: Subsidy for pulping units, drying yards, and eco-friendly processing equipment to improve coffee grade.
coffee.eligibility: Registered coffee growers with Coffee Board

jute.name: Minimum Support Price (MSP) for Raw Jute
jute.description: Government guaranteed purchase through JCI to ensure fair returns for jute farmers.

jute.name: Jute-ICARE (Improved Cultivation & Retting Exercise)
jute.description: Promotes improved cultivation practices with subsidized seed distribution and retting technology.
jute.eligibility: Jute farmers in major jute-growing states (WB, Bihar, Assam)

lentil.name: National Food Security Mission – Pulses (Lentil)
lentil.description: Promotes lentil production with subsidized seeds, integrated nutrient management, and demonstration plots.
lentil.eligibility: Lentil farmers in NFSM pulse districts

lentil.name: Minimum Support Price (MSP) for Lentil (Masur)
lentil.description: Government procurement at guaranteed MSP to stabilize lentil market prices and farmer income.

groundnut.name: Minimum Support Price (MSP) for Groundnut
groundnut.description: NAFED procures groundnut at MSP to prevent distress sales during peak harvest season.

groundnut.name: National Mission on Oilseeds & Oil Palm (NMOOP)
groundnut.description: Subsidized foundation seeds, plant protection, and cluster demonstrations for oilseed crops including groundnut.

soybean.name: Minimum Support Price (MSP) for Soybean
soybean.description: Government procurement at guaranteed MSP to incentivize soybean production and reduce edible oil imports.

soybean.name: National Mission on Oilseeds – Soybean
soybean.description: Promotes soybean cultivation through free seed mini-kits, bio-agent distribution, and integrated pest management.
soybean.eligibility: Soybean farmers in NMOOP target states (MP, Maharashtra, Rajasthan)

millet.name: National Food Security Mission – Nutri Cereals
millet.description: Promotes millet cultivation with subsidized seeds, bio-fertilizers, and farmer field schools under India's millet mission.
millet.eligibility: Millet farmers in NFSM nutri-cereal districts

millet.name: International Year of Millets (Continued Mission)
millet.description: Special funding for millet value-chain: processing units, branding, export promotion, and farmer awareness campaigns.
millet.benefitAmount: Up to ₹15 Lakh for processing units

mustard.name: Minimum Support Price (MSP) for Rapeseed/Mustard
mustard.description: Government procurement at MSP through NAFED to ensure remunerative returns for mustard farmers.

mustard.name: National Mission on Oilseeds – Mustard
mustard.description: Subsidized high-yielding mustard seed varieties, cluster demonstrations, and frontline demonstrations.
mustard.eligibility: Mustard farmers in NMOOP oilseed districts
